versions.changelog:
Smart Reminder 1.0.0

- Initial release of the smart-reminder skill.
- Supports 5 distinct reminder personalities (cute, energetic, formal, sarcastic, gentle).
- Allows custom user nicknames to personalize all reminders.
- Multi-frequency task tracking with progress display (e.g., "this week completed 1/3").
- Context-aware encouragement and feedback based on previous completion status.
- Deep cron scheduling integration for accurate timed reminders.
- Cross-channel delivery supported (e.g., set on web, remind on WeChat).
- All reminders, queries, and feedback use the selected personality and nickname.
